data.businessDescription: Pentair plc engages in the provision of water solutions for residential, commercial, industrial, infrastructure, and agricultural applications. It operates through the following segments: Flow, Water Solutions, and Pool. The Flow segment designs, manufactures, and sells various fluid treatment and pump products and systems. The Water Solutions segment covers commercial and residential water treatment products and systems, including commercial ice machines. The Pool segment refers to a line of energy-efficient residential and commercial pool equipment and accessories. Headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Air, Liquid and Gas Control Equipment

data.businessDescription: Savills Plc engages in the provision of corporate finance advice, investment management, and property related financial services. Segments: Transaction Advisory, Consultancy, Property and Facilities Management, and Investment Management. Founded 1855, headquartered in London.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Other Real Estate Investment and Services

data.businessDescription: Burford Capital Ltd. engages in the provision of legal finance products and services comprising core legal finance and alternative strategies, and in the asset management business. Segments: Principal Finance and Asset Management and Other Services. Headquartered in St. Peter Port, Guernsey.

Leroy Seafood Group ASA engages in the distribution, sale, and marketing of seafood products. Segments: Wildcatch (trawlers, whitefish processing); Farming (salmon and trout); and Value-added Processing, Sales, and Distribution. Subsidiary of Austevoll Seafood ASA. Headquartered in Bergen, Norway.

Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG manufactures and sells coated recycled carton boards and folding cartons. Divisions: MM Food & Premium Packaging, MM Board & Paper (carton board, linerboard, uncoated fine papers, kraft papers, pulp), and MM Pharma & Healthcare Packaging. Headquartered in Vienna, Austria.

Super Group (SGHC) Ltd. is a global digital gaming company in online sports betting and gaming: Betway (sportsbook and casino) and Spin (multi-brand online casino). Founded July 2020, headquartered in St. Peter Port, Guernsey.
Asseco Poland SA provides information technology solutions. Segments: Finance and Banking, Healthcare and Public Administration, General Business, and Other. Headquartered in Rzeszow, Poland.
Covivio SA is a property investment company: France Offices, Italy Offices, Hotels in Europe, German Residential, Germany Offices. Headquartered in Paris, France.
Coats Group Plc is a Tier 2 manufacturer and partner for the apparel and footwear industries (industrial thread, components, software). Founded 1909, headquartered in London.
Pets At Home Group Plc retails pets, pet food and accessories and operates a Vet Group (general practice veterinary). Segments: Retail, Vet Group, Central, Insurance. Headquartered in Handforth, UK.

Jazz Pharmaceuticals Plc is a biopharmaceutical company in narcolepsy, oncology, pain, and psychiatry. Products include Xyrem, Xywav, Epidiolex, Zepzelca, Rylaze, Vyxeos, Defitelio. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
BT Group Plc provides communications services. Segments: Consumer, Business, Global, Openreach (fixed network). Headquartered in London.

Barco NV designs visualization solutions. Segments: Healthcare (diagnostic displays), Enterprise (control rooms, ClickShare collaboration), Entertainment (cinema projection, LED). Headquartered in Kortrijk, Belgium.

Verallia SA produces glass packaging for food and beverage products in Southern & Western Europe, Northern & Eastern Europe, and Latin America. Controlled by BWGI (Brasil Warrant). Headquartered in Courbevoie, France.
Greencore Group Plc manufactures and supplies convenience foods (sandwiches, salads, sushi, chilled ready meals, soups, sauces) mainly for UK grocers. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.

VINCI SA designs, builds, finances and manages transport infrastructure and facilities. Segments: Concessions (motorways, airports), Energy (Cobra, Energies), Construction. Headquartered in Nanterre, France.
LEG Immobilien SE acquires, sells and leases residential real estate in North Rhine-Westphalia and neighbouring states. Headquartered in Dusseldorf, Germany.
Zegona Communications Plc acquires and operates telecommunications, media and technology businesses (owner of Vodafone Spain). Headquartered in London.

Constellium SE designs and manufactures rolled and extruded aluminum products: Packaging and Automotive Rolled Products, Aerospace and Transportation, Automotive Structures and Industry. Headquartered in Paris, France.
Andritz AG provides plants, equipment, and services: Pulp & Paper, Metals, Environment & Energy, Hydropower. Headquartered in Graz, Austria.
